title: Fix duplicate orders, out-of-order status events and stale cache in order-service
prompt: You are working in environment/order-service, a Spring Boot service. Read environment/BUG_REPORT.md (ticket ORD-2291) and the docs it points to, then fix the service so the three reported symptoms no longer happen. Constraints: keep every behaviour documented in docs/API.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md; existing unit tests must keep passing (you may extend them); schema changes go in a new Flyway migration; do not change the Kafka producers, the compose file or the docs. You can run `mvn -q test` for unit tests and `docker compose up -d --build` from environment/ for the full stack; tools/send_status.py publishes status events. When you are done, make sure `mvn -q test` is green and summarise what was wrong and what you changed.

budget.notes: Record the actual budget used per attempt in results/attempts/.

deliverable: a git diff of environment/order-service against the shipped tree

grading.command: cd grader && python run_grader.py --source <agent environment dir> --label <attempt id>
grading.pass_condition: summary.passed == true: every bug scenario passes and no contract scenario regresses

known_traps: returning 409 for a concurrent retry instead of the documented 200 + Idempotent-Replayed
enforcing a status state machine; CANCELLED after SHIPPED and PAID -> SHIPPED are both valid
fixing the self-invocation @CacheEvict but evicting before the transaction commits
using < instead of <= in the sequence guard
publishing OrderCreated inside the transaction before the row is committed
editing V1__orders.sql instead of adding V2
